building.ants.barracks.name: Soldier Burrow
building.ants.barracks.description: Hatches Raiders (two at a time), Needlers, Bursters and Majors.
building.ants.bombardier-workshop.name: Deep Gallery
building.ants.bombardier-workshop.descri: Galleries of the specialised castes: hatches Honeypots and Alates, and Bullet Ants once the Queen's Chamber stands. Requires a Great Nest.
building.ants.elder-hall.name: Queen's Chamber
building.ants.elder-hall.description: Hall tier 3 and a tunnel mound: unlocks the Queen's Cradle, the Bullet Ant, the Venom Spire, level III research and Wider Tunnels II.
building.ants.fort.name: Nest
building.ants.fort.description: The colony's main hall and its first tunnel mound: stores goods, hatches Workers and provides 15 supply. Ants travel between mounds underground. Upgrades to the Great Nest.
building.ants.fungus-garden.name: Fungus Garden
building.ants.fungus-garden.description: The colony's substance garden: one-off upgrades for every caste. Requires a Great Nest.
building.ants.great-mound.name: Great Nest
building.ants.great-mound.description: Hall tier 2 and a tunnel mound: unlocks the Fungus Garden, the Scent Hall, the Deep Gallery, tier-2 troops and level II research. Upgrades to the Queen's Chamber once a Deep Gallery stands.
building.ants.house.name: Brood Mound
building.ants.house.description: Brood chambers around a tunnel shaft: provides 8 supply and is a tunnel mound. Researches Wider Tunnels.
building.ants.ironroot-forge.name: Chitin Works
building.ants.ironroot-forge.description: Grows weapons and armour for the colony: Mandibles, Needle Hardening and Carapace, three levels each. Level II needs a Great Nest, level III the Queen's Chamber.
building.ants.queens-cradle.name: Queen's Cradle
building.ants.queens-cradle.description: The amber reliquary where Reaver Queens are raised. Requires the Queen's Chamber.
building.ants.sanctuary.name: Royal Chamber
building.ants.sanctuary.description: Where the colony's heroes are raised and revived: the Queen, the Royal Alchemist and the General.
building.ants.scent-hall.name: Scent Hall
building.ants.scent-hall.description: Where the pheromone castes are raised: hatches Heralds and Gardeners. Requires a Great Nest.
building.ants.substance-well.name: Substance Siphon
building.ants.substance-well.description: Built on a Substance Deposit: its clay spires bow to pour raw substance into a glowing pool. Pumps 10 Substance every 5 seconds by itself; no workers needed. When it falls, the deposit remains.
building.ants.tower.name: Acid Spire
building.ants.tower.description: A spire with a Needler spitting from its mouth at ground and air units. Upgrades to the Venom Spire once the Queen's Chamber stands.
building.ants.venom-spire.name: Venom Spire
building.ants.venom-spire.description: An Acid Spire grown venomous: its spitter deals 26 spell damage and each hit lowers armor by 2. Requires the Queen's Chamber.
building.beetles.alembic.name: Alembic
building.beetles.alembic.description: Distillery of the specialists who handle substance through devices: trains Arcwrights, Menders and Wardens and researches Specialist Training. Requires a Great Bastion.
building.beetles.ancestor-shrine.name: Ancestor Shrine
building.beetles.ancestor-shrine.descrip: Where the colony’s heroes are called and reconstituted: trains the Hornbreaker, the Forgemaster and the Coilkeeper, and revives the fallen.
building.beetles.arc-tower.name: Arc Tower
building.beetles.arc-tower.description: A Hornwatch refitted with a substance coil: its arcs deal 30 spell damage and jump to three more enemies. Requires an Elder Bastion.
building.beetles.bastion.name: Bastion
building.beetles.bastion.description: The beetle colony’s iron-clad main hall: stores goods, trains Tinkers, provides 15 supply and feeds the substance network. Upgrades to the Great Bastion.
building.beetles.brood-den.name: Brood Den
building.beetles.brood-den.description: An iron-banded shell nursery: provides 8 supply and extends the substance network with a generous radius. Researches Pressure Mains once a Great Bastion stands.
building.beetles.elder-bastion.name: Elder Bastion
building.beetles.elder-bastion.descripti: Hall tier 3, upgraded once an Engine Yard stands: unlocks the Juggernaut, level III research, Specialist Training Master, the Arc Tower and a third hero.
building.beetles.engine-yard.name: Engine Yard
building.beetles.engine-yard.description: Machine works: builds Bombards, Steamwings and the Juggernaut, and researches Fragmentation Shells, Riveted Hulls and Afterburners. Requires a Great Bastion.
building.beetles.great-bastion.name: Great Bastion
building.beetles.great-bastion.descripti: Hall tier 2: unlocks the Alembic, the Engine Yard and tier-2 troops, a second hero, level II research and Pressure Mains at the Brood Dens. Upgrades to the Elder Bastion.
building.beetles.hornwatch.name: Hornwatch
building.beetles.hornwatch.description: Armored tower crewed by its own repeater gunner: shoots ground and air units for 24 damage, far harder than other races’ towers. Needs the substance network. Upgrades to the Arc Tower at tier 3.
building.beetles.shell-forge.name: Shell Forge
building.beetles.shell-forge.description: Forges weapons and plating for the colony: Weapon Edges, Bolt Calibre and Plating, three levels each. Level II needs a Great Bastion, level III an Elder Bastion.
building.beetles.substance-well.name: Substance Well
building.beetles.substance-well.descript: Built on a Substance Deposit. Pumps 10 Substance every 5 seconds by itself; no workers needed. When it falls, the deposit remains.
building.beetles.war-lodge.name: War Lodge
building.beetles.war-lodge.description: Iron-clad barracks for Shieldbearers, Bolters and Breachers. Researches Interlocking Shields, Drum Magazines and Heavy Pistons.
building.neutral.amber-cache.name: Amber Cache
building.neutral.amber-cache.description: A resin-sealed urn an ant colony hid and never came back for. Break it open for what it holds.
building.neutral.amber-mine.name: Amber Node
building.neutral.amber-mine.description: One miner extracts ten amber at a time; other workers queue. Five nodes form a standard amber site.
building.neutral.beetle-gate.name: Station Gate
building.neutral.beetle-gate.description: A beetle gate of riveted steel and brass across a road. Nothing passes until it is broken down.
building.neutral.corrupted-root.name: Substance Deposit
building.neutral.corrupted-root.descript: The forest's raw magic wells up here and never runs out. Build a Substance Well on it: the well pumps Substance by itself, with no workers. When the well falls, the deposit remains.
building.neutral.dew-spring.name: Dew Spring
building.neutral.dew-spring.description: Dew heavy with the forest's magic gathers in a stone bowl. Every unit near it slowly regains its mana.
building.neutral.merchant.name: Pill-Bug Peddler
building.neutral.merchant.description: A travelling trader and his cart of salves, flasks and trinkets. Bring a hero near to buy; what sells out comes back in time.
building.neutral.rubble.name: Collapsed Rubble
building.neutral.rubble.description: Packed clay, stone and snapped roots where a tunnel or a gap fell in. Nothing passes until it is broken through.
building.neutral.sap-spring.name: Sap Spring
building.neutral.sap-spring.description: Golden healing sap wells up from an old root. Every unit near it slowly regains its health.
building.neutral.seed-pod.name: Fallen Seed Pod
building.neutral.seed-pod.description: A woody husk fallen from the canopy, sweet sap still glowing between its seeds. Crack it open for a salve.
building.neutral.supply-crate.name: Beetle Supply Crate
building.neutral.supply-crate.descriptio: A riveted crate a beetle column left behind on the march. Break it open for what it holds.
